title.narrative: Fourth Greater Mekong Subregion Corridor Towns Development Project

description.narrative: The project will improve urban services and enhance regional economic connectivity in provincial capital towns of Kampong Cham, Kratie, and Stung Treng along the Greater Mekong Subregion (GMS) Central Corridor in Cambodia. The project will finance key urban environmental infrastructure and enhance institutional effectiveness with a focus on private sector engagement and information and communication technology-based public management systems, and the policy and planning environment for regional economic connectivity.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Institutional effectiveness, policy and planning environment for regional economic connectivity enhanced Indicator: At least 120 government staff (including all women staff at relevant positions) in the provincial governments increased digital billing system skills to operate digital billing systems-based public services. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Training sessions were organized in Stung Treng and Kampong Cham provinces on 24 April 2025.
A total of 122 participants (39% females (47)) attended the training sessions ((68 participants (47% females (32) in Stung Treng; and 54 participants (28% females (15) in Kampong Cham)). Data Source: Project Progress Reports

Output: Institutional effectiveness, policy and planning environment for regional economic connectivity enhanced Indicator: At least one ICT-based public management systems for improved work productivity and transparency in two provincial governments deployed. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: ICT based joint billing system with clean water will be enabled in Stung Treng and Kampong Cham for wastewater management services. In coordination with the system developers of SUMS and E-water (existing water supply billing systems in Kampong Cham and Stung Treng), CRISIL is supporting system modifications to water supply billing system to add the wastewater component into the system for roll-out of the joint billing system.
Final approval on quotations and contract is in process and software development will start soon.
For solid waste management, Samraam App is already used in Kampong Cham provincial town.
The CRISIL has developed and submitted an approach paper for development of SWM billing and collection system in Stung Treng. The ICT-based billing and collection system will be introduced to support the Stung Treng provincial authority in the SWM. Data Source: Project Progress Reports

Output: Urban environmental infrastructure improved Indicator: 448 households headed by women connected to the wastewater treatment system Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: 360 in Kampong Cham; and 88 in Stung Treng. Data Source: Project progress reports

Output: Urban environmental infrastructure improved Indicator: At least 157 km of trunk drainage and a separate wastewater collection pipeline were constructed. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: As of 31 December 2025:
Under construction in Kampong Cham: 95.12 km (sewer); 4.2 km (drainage). As of December 2025, 62.5 km of sewer completed; and 4.2 km of drainage completed.
Under construction in Stung Treng: 55.91 km (sewer); 1.9 km (drainage). As of December 2025, 38.85 km of sewer completed; and 0.9 km of drainage completed.
Kratie WWTP subproject: 44.21 km of sewer and 2.0 km of drainage was cancelled due to insufficient costs.
Kratie Storm Drainage and Pumping Station Subproject (CW07a): As of December 2025, 10.12% achieved and 700 m of box drain installed. Data Source: Project progress reports

Output: Urban environmental infrastructure improved Indicator: At least 20% of staff employed in O&M are women. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Indicator is on track.
- Kampong Cham: Executive level: USU 32%; SWMU: 7.6% (Average: 19.8%) and operational level: USU: N/A (to be established), SWMU: 29% (Average: 29%). Sub-average: 22.86%
- Kratie: Executive level: USU n/a (wastewater subproject cancelled); SWMU 31.25% (Average: 31.25%) and operational level: USU: n/z, SWMU: 30% (Average: 30%). Sub-average: 30.62%
- Stung Treng: Executive level: USU 34.5%; SWMU 34.5% (Average: 34.5%) and operational level: USU: 42%, SWMU: 42% (Average: 42%). Sub-average: 38.25%.
- All combined staff employed in O&M are women (30.57%). Data Source: Project progress reports

Output: Urban environmental infrastructure improved Indicator: At least 5,000 households and commercial buildings connected to the wastewater treatment system (including 448 households headed by women). Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: As of 31 December 2025:
- Kampong Cham: Total 4,155 connections: 3,740 HH connections included in the civil works contract (875 HH completed), 190 toilets and 225 buildings.
- Stung Treng: Total all connections 2,394 connections: 2,253 HH connections included in the civil works contract (298 HH connections completed), 60 toilets, 81 buildings.
- Total HH connected: 1,173; achieved: 23.46% - Total FHH connected: 39; achieved: 8.7% Data Source: Project progress reports

Output: Urban environmental infrastructure improved Indicator: Three controlled landfills with a capacity of 936,430 m3 were designed; at least 392,000 m3 were constructed and operational. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: As of 31 December 2025:
- Kampong Cham: Total design capacity of 361,402 m3 (3 cells), of which 129,567 m3 built (1 cell) against TOR 900,000 m3 identified during PPTA.
- Stung Treng: Total design capacity of 274,832 m3 (2 cells), of which 137,416 m3 built (1 cell) against TOR 291,000 m3 identified during PPTA.
- Kratie: Total design capacity of 300,196 m3 (2 cells), of which 125,035m3 built (1 cell) against TOR 433,500 m3 identified during PPTA.
The total volume designed is 936,430 m3. The total actual volume of landfills constructed is 392,018 m3 and operational.
Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Manual for Solid Waste Management in the Landfill Site of respective target provinces of Kg. Cham, Kratie and Stung Treng have been developed.
All three controlled landfills in Kratie, Stung Treng, and Kampong Cham, were completed and are in operation since April and July 2024 and February 2025, respectively. Data Source: Project progress reports

Output: Urban environmental infrastructure improved Indicator: Two new lagoon-based wastewater treatment plants with 7,900 m3/day capacity constructed. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: - Kampong Cham WWTP capacity is 5,000 m3/day - Stung Treng WWTP capacity is 2,900 m3/day - Kratie WWTP: WWTP capacity is, 2,400 m3/day, but this package was cancelled due to insufficient costs. Data Source: Project progress reports

Output: Institutional effectiveness, policy and planning environment for regional economic connectivity enhanced Indicator: Provincial spatial plans developed for Kampong Cham, Kratie and Stung Treng. Achievement: N Progress/Status: Final drafts of provincial spatial plans (PSP) prepared and submitted to MLMUPC. MLMUPC approved these plans and started the government approval process.
- PSP for KC: Completed and translated (2 Mar 2022 - English; 13 June 2022 - Khmer version).
- PSP for Kratie: Completed (31 Aug 2022); Translation completed and submitted for comments to PMU and MLMUPC.
- PSP for Stung Treng: Completed (3 Oct 2022 - English version). Translation completed and submitted to PMU and MLMUPC for comments.
Additional works: - Review of LUMP: translation completed (17 Dec 2022 - English; 13 June 2022 - Khmer).
- Review of LUMP - Kratie: translation completed (20 May 2022 - English; 13 June 2022 - Khmer). Data Source: Project Progress Reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Output: Urban environmental infrastructure improved Indicator: At least 16,000 m2 of pedestrian walk rehabilitated. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Indicator is on track.
The contracts for town center enhancement works, including the rehabilitation of pedestrian walk were signed on 3 July 2025.
ADB provided no objection to the EA to commence the construction on 1 and 2 September 2025, respectively. Data Source: Project progress reports
Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: 16000 Actual value: 0
Urban services for enhancing regional economic connectivity in participating towns improved

20% of the town population in Kampong Cham, Kratie, and Stung Treng (23,465 residents) serviced by new wastewater collection and treatment facilities. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: As of 31 December 2025:
Construction of wastewater treatment plants and their associated sewer networks, including storm drainage system in Kampong Cham and Stung Treng was 88% and 90% completed, respectively.
- Kampong Cham: Total connections are 4,155: 3,740 HH connections included in the civil works contract (371 HH completed), 190 Toilets, 225 buildings.
- Stung Treng: Total all connections 2,394 connections: 2,253 HH connections included in the civil works contract (205 HH connections completed), 60 Toilets, 81 Buildings.
- Kratie: Kratie wastewater treatment plant and its sewer network were dropped given the budget constraint through the memo of minor change in scope approved on 16 July 2025. Data Source: Annual reports by DPWTs and MPWT; project completion report Target value: 23,465

Incidence of flood and/or water logging reduced in the project service area. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Construction of drainage networks in Kampong Cham is achieved at about 80.70%.
Construction of Kratie Drainage Subproject (CW07a) started in Q1 2025 and is achieved at about 51.75% as of 31 December 2025.
Construction of Stung Treng Wastewater and Drainage (CW08) and actual progress by end of December 2025 is 90.81%. Data Source: Annual reports by DPWTs and MPWT; project completion report

90% of the town population in Kampong Cham, Kratie, and Stung Treng (104,500 residents) served by improved solid waste management. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: As of 31 December 2025:
- Construction of the three landfills have been completed and have been in operations till now.
- Landfills have been designed to provide improved service at landfill site for 100% of the town population.
Besides Kampong Cham landfills has been designed to provide service to Ampil, Ro'ang and Bos Khnor. The residents served by the subproject are above the target of 120,400. This amount however doesn't represent the 90% according to the population projections for 2027 (NIS, 2019). It is suggested to revise the target from 90% to 80% of the town population in Kampong Cham, Kratie and Stung Treng (120,400 residents) served by improved solid waste management. Data Source: Annual reports by DPWTs and MPWT; project completion report Baseline value: 48,000
